Before buying

The details that matter.

Is this a subscription?

The current plan is a one-time Pro licence, not a recurring subscription. Checkout is not available yet.

What does lifetime mean?

The planned licence covers this major version. It is not a promise that all future major versions will be included.

Is there a free trial?

No trial is planned. The free edition is intended to allow scanning and individual cleanup. The final entitlement behaviour still needs verification.

How many Macs will a key cover?

The activation allowance has not been confirmed. It will need to be stated before sales open.

Will a licence work offline?

The current implementation allows a previously verified licence to work offline for up to 30 days before another check is needed. Live activation, real Keychain behaviour and the customer licence flow still need release validation.

Can I buy or download it now?

Not yet. Check the current availability ↗ or read the licensing information ↗.
